Row.Text: Claims the land resource beneath it without expanding borders. Requires Engineering and the resource's normal extraction technology. Build on an unimproved strategic or luxury deposit in unclaimed land. Uses fort construction time and grants +50% defense. A military garrison is optional; no road, supply connection or Ministry is required, even with Realistic Terrain enabled. Base upkeep is 2 gold per turn, including pillaged sites. Abandon unwanted sites through the Resource Outposts control. Pillaging suspends extraction. An enemy military unit entering the neutral outpost captures it. City borders take precedence.

A fortified remote installation secures one strategic or luxury deposit for its civilization. Workers construct it directly on the resource, replacing the need for a separate mine, plantation, pasture, camp, quarry, or well. The deposit's base quantity becomes available for use and trade; it does not accumulate each turn. Surrounding tiles remain neutral. A stationed land military unit defends the outpost under ordinary combat rules. Pillaged outposts can be repaired. When city borders absorb the tile, its territorial owner receives the resource through the ordinary improvement rules. Resource Outposts provide no city yields. With Realistic Terrain enabled, an intact outpost shelters its own stationed defender from exposure, on this tile only. Roads and supply connections are never required for extraction or shelter. Base upkeep is 2 gold per turn; normal building-maintenance modifiers apply.
